request: Pull New York State nonprofit organizations from ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer (IRS Form 990-derived data). ~10k orgs (API caps at 10k results per search). One row per nonprofit. Enrich with ntee_family (map_values on ntee_code first character -> Arts_Culture / Education / Environment / Animals / Health / Human_Services / International / Public_Benefit / Religion / Other) and subsection_class (map_values on subseccd IRS 501(c) subsection: 3=public_charity, 4=civic_league, 5=labor, 6=business_league, 7=social, others=other). Publish to 'Prep Agent / 26 - NY Nonprofit Directory' on Tableau Server for state AG offices, community-planning agencies, and grantmakers vetting local nonprofits. ProPublica is Cloudflare-fronted at projects.propublica.org, reliable and no auth required.

sources.name: NY State Nonprofits (ProPublica)
sources.description: ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer search endpoint filtered on state=NY. Returns basic org info from IRS Form 990 filings. Fields per org: ein, strein (formatted EIN), name, sub_name, city, state, ntee_code (National Taxonomy of Exempt Entities, 1-4 alphanumeric), raw_ntee_code, subseccd (IRS 501(c) subsection code), has_subseccd, have_filings (Form 990 filed with detailed financials), have_extracts, have_pdfs, score (ProPublica search relevance). API caps at 10,000 results / 400 pages of 25 orgs each per query.

outputs.name: NY Nonprofit Directory
outputs.description: Directory of ~10,000 New York State nonprofit organizations from ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer (IRS Form 990-derived data). Fields: ein, strein (formatted EIN), name, sub_name, city, state, ntee_code (National Taxonomy of Exempt Entities), raw_ntee_code, subseccd (IRS 501(c) subsection code), subsection_class (public_charity_501c3, civic_league_501c4, labor_agricultural_501c5, business_league_501c6, social_recreational_501c7, others; from IRS subseccd), has_subseccd, have_filings (Form 990 filed - true means detailed financials available in ProPublica), have_extracts, have_pdfs, score (ProPublica relevance score). Source: projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/api/v2/search.json?state[id]=NY. API caps at 10k results per query. Refresh: monthly. Use for: state AG oversight of nonprofit sector, grantmaker due-diligence, county-planning agencies mapping service providers by NTEE domain.
